reps_or_seconds: Hardest level with 8+ good reps and the reps you got
notes: Start at the push level you think is easy. Do one set of as many good-form reps as you can. If you reach the cap, rest 2 min and try the next level. Maximum 3 attempts.

reps_or_seconds: Hardest level with 8+ good reps and the reps you got
notes: Same as the push test using the pull ladder. Use the no-bar track unless you have a pull-up bar.

reps_or_seconds: Hardest level with 8+ good reps and the reps you got
notes: Same as the push test using the squat ladder. For one-leg levels, test your weaker side.

reps_or_seconds: Hardest level with 8+ good reps and the reps you got
notes: Same as the push test using the hinge ladder. Hinge moves are easier, so the cap is 20.
Hold a forearm plank with good form. Stop when your hips sag or pike. Under 20 s: start core at Dead Bug. 20-45 s: start at Forearm Plank. Over 45 s: try Tuck Hollow Hold.

reps_or_seconds: Seconds held per side and which version
notes: Hold a knee side plank (or full side plank if easy) on each side. Under 30 s: start at Knee Side Plank. 30 s or more on a full side plank: start at Side Plank.
Squat as low as is comfortable with heels down and hold 20 s.

reps_or_seconds: Reached: knees / shins / ankles / toes / floor
notes: Stand tall, knees straight, slowly reach toward your toes. Do not bounce.

reps_or_seconds: Thumbs touch the wall? yes / no
notes: Stand with back, head and heels against a wall. Raise straight arms overhead without arching your back.
